name: repeated_grep
description: A byte-identical repeat of a recent search must collapse to a receipt, exactly like a repeated read.
prompt: Search for MARKER twice and report how many files matched.

alpha.txt.repeat_text: MARKER alpha occurrence {index:02d} with enough text to pass the deduplication floor.

beta.txt.repeat_text: MARKER beta occurrence {index:02d} with enough text to pass the deduplication floor.

respond.content: Two files matched: alpha.txt and beta.txt.
